name: Algebraic Substitution of Graph Complement
description: Replaced the inclusion-exclusion formula (sum of degrees minus union size equals 3) with an algebraically equivalent form using the complement (sum of degrees plus edges involving none equals total edges plus 3). This hides the union operation that models use to pattern-match the triangle condition, forcing them to either do the algebra or implement a naive O(n^3) count that will Time Out.
